description: Create a Cloud Hadoop notebook instance (a billable server) attached to an existing cluster. Use dryRun=true to preview.

cloudHadoopNotebookImageProductCode.description: Notebook image code (from ncloud_hadoop_list_notebook_images). Default: latest

cloudHadoopNotebookName.description: Notebook name (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, '-'; starts with a letter, ends with a letter or number)

engineVersionCode.description: Engine version code (for Rocky). Not in the Financial-zone guide

loginKeyName.description: Login key name for SSH access

notebookNodeDataStorageSize.description: Storage GB (100-2000 in 10 GB steps, or 4000, 6000) — required when useNotebookBlockStorage=true

notebookNodeDataStorageTypeCode.description: Storage type SSD | HDD (CB2 also in the Public zone) — when useNotebookBlockStorage=true

notebookNodeProductCode.description: Notebook node server type code (from ncloud_hadoop_list_notebook_products)

name: ncloud_hadoop_create_notebook
